title: Skrzypiec 2007 outer AF hydration before and after simulated tensile testing in air

quantity.name: hydration
quantity.definition: water content of whole outer AF specimens (freeze-dried to constant weight), control vs after a simulated 5-min test in air

source.authors: Skrzypiec D, Tarala M, Pollintine P, Dolan P, Adams MA
source.sample: 132 successfully tested AF slices (39 inner, 46 middle, 47 outer) from discs adjacent to 47 thoracolumbar motion segments (T8-T9 to L5-S1) of 30 cadavers (20 female, 27 male segments); degeneration grades 1-4 (mostly 2-3)

protocol.summary: Five outer AF specimens taken through the testing procedure without adhesive and without failure, then freeze-dried; five adjacent controls dried immediately.
how_to_simulate: Not a mechanical target; documents test-induced dehydration (<10 % in the central region per the authors)

extraction.check_notes: 'Hydration of (whole) outer anulus specimens averaged 63 % initially and 57.5 % after simulated testing (P < 0.05)'. Definition of hydration (water/wet weight) not stated.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
